description:
MOSS-Image SFT can produce noticeable vertical color banding, particularly in skies, gradients, fog, and large areas of uniform color.

These two weight-difference adapters reduce the artifact by restoring selected transformer layers to their MOSS-Image Base weights, without requiring a full replacement checkpoint.

Main (L37–41) provides the standard correction and can be used on its own at strength 1.0.

Extra (L32–36) extends the correction when stacked with Main, also at strength 1.0. Using both produces the stronger DeBand+ configuration.

The included ComfyUI workflow provides presets for different quality and speed configurations.

These files use ComfyUI's full-rank .diff format rather than conventional low-rank LoRA matrices. Use a compatible ComfyUI loader.
